title: Add bounded autonomy soak tick history
summary: Add an explicit bounded diagnostics-state history writer for autonomy soak tick results.
reason: The 7-day pilot needs compact after-the-fact tick evidence without requiring the operator to watch the UI or logs continuously.
behavior_before: The autonomy soak tick could evaluate health and optionally record growth snapshots, but it did not persist a compact per-tick audit trail.
behavior_after: The autonomy soak tick can explicitly persist bounded compact tick records under diagnostics state while remaining read-only by default.
